text:
ravi: noticed a mismatch in the API reference headers section for request tracing. the curl examples and OpenAPI show `Request-Id` while our runtime and gateways use `X-Request-Id`. this breaks a bunch of customer traces. opened PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991

aria: ugh, good catch. i remember we changed the edge proxy to emit X-Request-Id for consistency with other infra. docs must reflect that and the SDK helpers that inject the header. can you paste where it's wrong?

ravi: page snippet currently has:
```http
GET /v1/models
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Request-Id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
that led a customer to set `Request-Id` and then wonder why their telemetry didn't correlate.

jamie: SDKs set `request_id` meta which maps to `X-Request-Id` header on the wire. if docs show `Request-Id` it creates a mismatch where users manually set the wrong header. i'll update the SDK README examples too.

aria: two parts: 1) update all examples (curl, python, go, openapi header param) to show `X-Request-Id`; 2) add a migration note explaining older docs used `Request-Id` and how to migrate existing instrumentation. i'll also add a docs-test that searches the rendered site for `Request-Id` occurrences.

docs-bot: lint check flagged OpenAPI mismatch: components.parameters.RequestId.name expected 'X-Request-Id', found 'Request-Id'. failing path: /v1/models get. CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/1500/logs/321 :warning:

ravi: pushed a patch to the PR updating the YAML and replaced the curl/python snippets. also included a small code snippet showing how to set the header in Python:```py
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "X-Request-Id": uuid4().hex}
resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
```

jamie: pushed SDK README fix and opened sdk PR to normalize header mapping across languages: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/912. i also added a helper `client.set_request_id(id)` in the examples.

aria: re-ran docs linter. docs-bot: CI failure earlier due to missed occurrences in the sidebar search index. i updated the content pipeline to scrub `Request-Id` tokens from generated search documents. CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference/1500/builds/777 :x:

docs-bot: CI re-run succeeded after index fix (build 778) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood-inference/1500/builds/778

tom: support confirms a customer unblocked after changing to `X-Request-Id`. can we add a short note in the changelog and migration guide pointing out that telemetry dashboards should look for `X-Request-Id` and that the header is preserved across edge -> runtime -> logs? makes it easier for SEs.

aria: added a 1-paragraph migration note under /docs/migration/header-naming.md and linked it from the API ref. also added a tiny unit test that fetches the rendered /api-reference/models page and asserts the header line contains `X-Request-Id`.

ravi: thanks all. merging once CI green. closing after merge. :tada:
